name: nvm
label: nvm
description: Node.js from .nvmrc or .node-version (with its npm); pnpm, yarn and bun from package.json's packageManager; TypeScript; or a default for each.

tools.name: pnpm
install: r="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/xherd/pnpm"; d="$r/$1"; test -x "$d/bin/pnpm" && exit 0; mkdir -p "$r" && t=$(mktemp -d "$r/.tmp.XXXXXX") && { npm install -g --prefix "$t" --no-audit --no-fund "pnpm@$1" </dev/null && mv -T "$t" "$d"; } || { rm -rf "$t"; test -x "$d/bin/pnpm"; }
list: npm view pnpm versions --json </dev/null | jq -r '.[]' | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | sort -ruV | head -80

tools.name: yarn
install: r="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/xherd/yarn"; d="$r/$1"; test -x "$d/bin/yarn" && exit 0; case "$1" in 0.*|1.*) p=yarn;; *) p=@yarnpkg/cli-dist;; esac; mkdir -p "$r" && t=$(mktemp -d "$r/.tmp.XXXXXX") && { npm install -g --prefix "$t" --no-audit --no-fund "$p@$1" </dev/null && mv -T "$t" "$d"; } || { rm -rf "$t"; test -x "$d/bin/yarn"; }
list: { npm view yarn versions --json </dev/null; npm view @yarnpkg/cli-dist versions --json </dev/null; } | jq -r '.[]' | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | sort -ruV | head -80

tools.name: bun
install: r="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/xherd/bun"; d="$r/$1"; test -x "$d/bin/bun" && exit 0; mkdir -p "$r" && t=$(mktemp -d "$r/.tmp.XXXXXX") && { npm install -g --prefix "$t" --no-audit --no-fund "bun@$1" </dev/null && mv -T "$t" "$d"; } || { rm -rf "$t"; test -x "$d/bin/bun"; }
list: npm view bun versions --json </dev/null | jq -r '.[]' | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | sort -ruV | head -80

tools.name: typescript
install: r="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/xherd/typescript"; d="$r/$1"; test -x "$d/bin/tsc" && exit 0; mkdir -p "$r" && t=$(mktemp -d "$r/.tmp.XXXXXX") && { npm install -g --prefix "$t" --no-audit --no-fund "typescript@$1" </dev/null && mv -T "$t" "$d"; } || { rm -rf "$t"; test -x "$d/bin/tsc"; }
list: npm view typescript versions --json </dev/null | jq -r '.[]' | grep -E '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | sort -ruV | head -80

tools.name: node
install: . "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" --no-use && nvm install "$1" </dev/null && PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which "$1")"):$PATH" corepack enable 2>/dev/null; true
list: . "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" --no-use && nvm ls-remote --no-colors </dev/null | grep -oE '^[ >-]*v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | tr -d ' >-' | sort -ruV | head -80

requires.name: nvm
check: if . "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" --no-use >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; echo "nvm not found (install it: https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm, or set NVM_DIR)" >&2; exit 1

instructions.any: curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.1/install.sh | bash   # then open a new shell; see https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm
